## Purpose
Two rehearsals of the planner's own machinery: what a goal narrows the ontology down to (scope), and how a resource description gets classified.

## Responsibilities
- `ScopePanel` uses `ontologyApi.scope` and `scopeGraph` (`ScopedGraph`).
- `ClassifyPanel` uses `ontologyApi.classify`. `ConceptRow`.
